title: Anchor with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Background circle removed, no background -->
  
  <!-- Anchor shank (main vertical bar) -->
  <rect x="46" y="18" width="8" height="52" rx="4" fill="#5B9BD5"/>
  <!-- Lighter highlight on shank -->
  <rect x="47" y="20" width="3" height="48" rx="1.5" fill="#8DC6F0"/>
  
  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#4A86C8" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#8DC6F0" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Stock (horizontal crossbar) -->
  <rect x="30" y="28" width="40" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#4A86C8"/>
  <rect x="32" y="29" width="36" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8DC6F0"/>
  
  <!-- Left fluke (curved arm) -->
  <path d="M50 62 Q30 72 22 62 Q14 52 22 46 Q28 42 34 48 L36 56 Q32 52 28 54 Q24 56 28 60 Q34 64 50 62Z" fill="#5B9BD5"/>
  
  <!-- Right fluke (curved arm) -->
  <path d="M50 62 Q70 72 78 62 Q86 52 78 46 Q72 42 66 48 L64 56 Q68 52 72 54 Q76 56 72 60 Q66 64 50 62Z" fill="#4A86C8"/>
  
  <!-- Bottom point of anchor -->
  <path d="M42 66 Q50 82 58 66 Q54 74 50 76 Q46 74 42 66Z" fill="#5B9BD5"/>
  
  <!-- Face on shank -->
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="42" r="3" fill="#FFE88D"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#3A3A5C"/>
  
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="42" r="3" fill="#FFE88D"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#3A3A5C"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M42 50 Q50 60 58 50" fill="none" stroke="#FFE88D" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="48" r="3" fill="#FFB3C1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="48" r="3" fill="#FFB3C1" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Decorative dots on flukes -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="54" r="1.5" fill="#FFE88D"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="54" r="1.5" fill="#FFE88D"/>
  
  <!-- Little sparkle on stock -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="31" r="1" fill="#FFE88D"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="31" r="1" fill="#FFE88D"/>
</svg>
